links.comparator_used: Radiologist interpretation without AI assistance (widget inactive, phase 1) versus with the AI triage widget active (phase 2)
links.outcome: Radiologist sensitivity for incidental pulmonary embolism on contrast-enhanced chest or abdominal CT; report turnaround time for IPE-positive examinations
links.effect: Sensitivity 80.0% without AI vs 96.2% with AI (p = .03); specificity 99.9% vs 99.9% (p = .58); mean turnaround for IPE-positive examinations 78.3 vs 74.6 minutes (p = .26)
links.quote: An AI triage system improved radiologists' sensitivity for IPE detection on CECT examinations of the chest or abdomen without significant change in report turnaround times.
